$comment: This session's prior turns and the live query. Every prior turn carries a supplied summary, precomputed before freezing (R-18), so budget pressure can replace a turn with its summary instead of dropping it.

turns.body: Hi. We upgraded our Acme Cloud workspace from Free to Pro at the start of September, twelve seats, EU region. I want to understand what that changes for support before I brief my team.
turns.summary: User upgraded from Free to Pro in September, 12 seats, EU; wants to brief the team on support changes.

turns.body: Congratulations on the upgrade. I can walk you through what Pro includes for support. Is there a particular area you care about most: response times, phone support, or ticket limits?
turns.summary: Assistant offered to explain Pro support and asked which area matters most.

turns.body: Mostly response times and whether we can call someone when something breaks at night. One of our engineers is in Sydney.
turns.summary: User cares about response times and night-time phone support; an engineer is in Sydney.

turns.body: Understood. Let me check your account and the current support documentation so I can give you the entitlement for your plan rather than a general answer.
turns.summary: Assistant said it would check the account and the current documentation.

query.body: Given my account and our previous conversation, what support am I entitled to?
